failure.error: Mastra observational-storage initialization raised SQLITE_BUSY on a fresh shared file when app-owned CaseStore migrations had initialized independently before Mastra composite storage.

fix: Use installed MastraCompositeStore.init() from mastra.getStorage() as the canonical initialization promise.
CaseStore waits for that promise before its own migrations and applies PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000.
LibSQLStore uses the supported connectionTimeoutMs=30000 configuration.
Characterization cleanup calls mastra.shutdown() before deleting each temporary database, preventing old module instances from retaining file handles.
